title: Xtra power Keyless Drill Chuck, 13mm x 20UNF
description: The Xtra power Keyless Drill Chuck offers a convenient and efficient solution for your drilling needs. With a 13mm capacity and 20UNF thread specification, this keyless chuck eliminates the need for traditional chuck keys, allowing for quick and easy bit changes with just a hand-tightening motion. The keyless design saves valuable time during projects and reduces the risk of losing chuck keys. This drill chuck is compatible with various power drills and drilling machines that feature a 20UNF thread mount. The 13mm capacity accommodates a wide range of drill bit sizes, making it versatile for different drilling applications from woodworking to metalworking. The robust construction ensures reliable grip and secure bit retention during operation. Whether you're a professional tradesperson or a DIY enthusiast, this keyless chuck provides the convenience and functionality needed for efficient drilling tasks. The user-friendly design allows for single-handed operation, improving productivity on the job site or in your workshop.

specifications.Compatible Devices: Cordless Drill, Drill Press, Electric Drill, Power Drill
